class: infra — persistent emulator boot failure (host-direct+HVF, darwin/arm64); adbd stays offline
supersedes_hypothesis: The 2026-06-02-emulator-boot-wedge.json PENDING_FORENSICS hypothesis ('a host reboot would clear it') is DISPROVEN: the host WAS rebooted (uptime 41 min at first attempt today) and the emulator STILL fails to boot.
summary: Across ~8 cold-boot attempts spanning two sessions + a host reboot, the Pixel_8/API35 emulator (Containers runner, host-direct+HVF) launches (qemu runs at ~370% CPU) but never reaches sys.boot_completed within the timeout (boot_seconds approximately equals the 5m or 15m timeout every run). It booted green TWICE at 2026-06-02 11:35 (item-1 api-app C01-C04 gate). The degradation appeared after that and persists across a reboot.

captured_root_cause_signal.adb_devices: emulator-5554 shows state 'offline' (transport never reaches 'device'); a phantom 'localhost:5555 offline' TCP entry was also present and was disconnected. After dropping the phantom + adb kill-server/start-server + a wiped clean AVD, a fresh boot STILL timed out offline.
captured_root_cause_signal.interpretation: The emulator's adbd never completes its handshake, so the runner's `adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed` poll can never succeed. The 'offline' state is the symptom; the underlying cause (HVF/adbd/host emulator state) is UNCONFIRMED.

hypotheses_eliminated_this_cycle: AVD-overlay corruption — eliminated (full qcow2/userdata wipe, still fails)
memory pressure — eliminated (gradle --stop freed ~930MB, still fails)

stale qemu zombie holding AVD lock — real secondary issue (the runner does NOT reap qemu on boot-timeout, leaving a ~370% CPU process that locks the AVD + starves the next boot); reaped manually each time; boot still fails on the next clean attempt
phantom localhost:5555 offline adb device — dropped via adb disconnect + kill-server; boot still fails offline
PENDING_FORENSICS: The mechanism that makes adbd stay 'offline' on this host as of 2026-06-03 is UNCONFIRMED. Candidate-but-unverified contributors: Kaspersky AV (observed 168-395% CPU scanning emulator/APK writes) interfering with the emulator's networking/file IO; a stale host emulator/HVF kernel state not cleared by reboot; an AVD that needs full recreation via AVD Manager. Tracked-task: operator to (a) add a Kaspersky exclusion for ~/.android + the Android SDK + the repo build dirs, and/or (b) recreate the Pixel_8 AVD from scratch, and/or (c) run the §6.Z gate on a different/clean Linux x86_64+KVM or quiet macOS host. The Containers runner reap-on-timeout + offline-adb-handling fix (Stream A, in progress) removes the zombie/lock self-sabotage but cannot fix a host where adbd genuinely will not come up.
